title: Soulcaster Config, schema version 1
description: PROTOTYPE. A Config lists what a Machine should have. Every object is closed: a field this schema doesn't name is an error, which is what keeps shell commands, trust grants, removal flags and includes out. Whether an Item ID exists and whether a settings value suits its Item are checked against the Catalog after this schema passes, entry by entry.

$schema.description: Editor hint for completion and checking. The app never fetches it.

schemaVersion.description: The format version. An app that doesn't know this number refuses the file and changes nothing.

name.description: Shown in the app. There is no description field: prose belongs in the Config Repo's README.

items.description: Catalog Items to install or complete: apps, CLIs and sign-ins. Settings go in `settings`.

packages.description: Homebrew packages the Catalog doesn't cover. Names only: no options, versions or trust.

taps.description: Third-party taps wanted with no package named from them. A package written owner/tap/name already implies its tap.

settings.description: Setting Item ID to desired value. Leaving an ID out means the app doesn't manage that setting.

dotfiles.description: The Dotfiles Repo. The clone location is a Machine-local value, so it isn't here.

repo.description: owner/repo on GitHub, or an https URL with no credentials in it.

links.description: Link location on the Machine to path inside the Dotfiles Repo. One link per line, and two links can't claim the same location.

installScript.description: Path of one script inside the Dotfiles Repo, with no arguments. It runs only after approval on the Machine, which is tied to the script's contents.

itemId.description: Lowercase kebab-case product name with no category or delivery method in it, such as ghostty or gh-sign-in. It has no dots, so a setting ID fails here.

settingId.description: <surface>.<name>, such as dock.autohide. Keys that look like secrets or Git identity are refused, because those values belong on the Machine.

settingValue.description: A value the Catalog types and checks. There is no null, because leaving the ID out is the only way to say unmanaged, and no nested objects.

settingString.description: Best effort only: refuses common token prefixes, private keys, email addresses and home-folder paths. The real guard is that values only reach typed Catalog settings.

formulaName.description: A homebrew-core name, or owner/tap/name for a third-party formula. Lowercase, starts with a letter or digit, and has one spelling: homebrew/core/x is written x.

caskName.description: A homebrew/cask name, or owner/tap/name for a third-party cask. Same rules as formulaName.

tapName.description: owner/tap. Official homebrew/ taps are never listed. Custom tap URLs aren't supported in version 1.

linkTarget.description: Inside the home folder, written with ~/. No absolute paths, no $HOME and no .. segments.

repoPath.description: Relative to the Dotfiles Repo root, and can't climb out of it.
